heading: Our Service
subtext: From concept to completion, we shape every element of your workspace — furniture, fixtures, and structures — so the result feels cohesive, functional, and distinctly yours.

services.title: CEO/MD Desk
services.description: Bespoke executive desks tailored to leadership presence — ergonomic engineering, premium finishes, and built-in tech anchoring the modern corner office.

services.title: Conference Desk
services.description: Conference and boardroom tables sized and finished for productive meetings — from intimate six-seaters to full boardroom leadership.

services.title: Reception Desk
services.description: Reception counters that set the tone for every visitor — brand presence, wayfinding cues, and durable surfaces for daily traffic.

services.title: Workstation
services.description: Modular workstations engineered for focused individual output — acoustic screens, sit-stand options, and cable channels that disappear into clean lines.

services.title: Lab Furniture
services.description: Chemical-resistant lab benches, fume-cupboard cabinets, and modular service units built around the realities of research and instruction.

services.title: Cafeteria Furniture
services.description: Cafeteria and pantry seating designed for high traffic and fast clean-up — ergonomic chairs, durable tables, and layouts that ease the lunch rush.

services.title: Education Furniture
services.description: Classroom, seminar, and library furniture that supports how students actually learn — movable desks, stackable seating, and collaborative cluster layouts.

services.title: Wardrobe & Storage
services.description: Built-in wardrobes, wall storage, and cabinetry that turn clutter into calm — finished in materials that match the rest of the space.

services.title: Sofas
services.description: Lounge and reception seating shaped for long conversations and short waits — fabric and leather upholstery on frames built for daily use.

services.title: PV & LGST Structure
services.description: Solar PV mounting structures and lightning-arrestor frameworks fabricated to site and certified to specification — engineered for Indian rooftop conditions.
